Elected Officials
In addition to nine county commissioners elected by districts,
there are several countywide elected officials and judges.
Board of Commissioners
The Board of County Commissioners is a nine-member governing board elected at-large to represent the citizens of Jackson County to ensure the future of Jackson County.

Appointed Officials
Jackson County has one Appointed Official serving the constituents of Jackson County, Michigan. The County Administrator is appointed by and reports to the County Board of Commissioners.
Administrator/
Controller
Michael Overton |
Boards and Commissions
The County Board of Commissioners in each Michigan County has the statutory responsibility of making various appointments to boards and commissions. The roles of individuals appointed to these various boards and commissions vary depending on the statutory nature of the appointment.
County Departments
County departments manage services, regulations, infrastructure, finance, safety,
and community well-being for effective local governance.
County Courts
The Jackson County Courts is a forum for dispute resolution built on a foundation of personal integrity, equal and informed access and fairness, by a team committed to efficient, timely and innovative services for our community.
